summary: What you want and what you need can become so closely tied together that one decision suddenly feels capable of resetting the whole emotional landscape.
body: What you want and what you need can become so closely tied together that one decision suddenly feels capable of resetting the whole emotional landscape. When the Sun conjoins the Moon, intention and feeling fuse, concentrating your attention around whatever seems most personally important right now. That clarity can help you choose a direction, but it can also make the present mood feel like the only truth available. Start from what feels essential. You do not need to turn one strong feeling into a permanent verdict on everything that came before it.
